THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
STREET & CITY
188
STUDY 122
Purple Velvet Crop & Burnout Skirt
Rights check / Repeats Study 142.
Source: 25023.jpg
Nostalgic, moody, boho
WORKING NOTES
- The velvet crop and chain belt with cross charm are the
key details.
- Keep the path and grass for an organic, walking motion.
Try this: Keep the path and grass for a sense of walking
motion.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
wavy honey-blonde hair walks a dirt path
through tall grass. She wears a purple
velvet cropped long-sleeve top with
flared cuffs, a black velvet burnout maxi
skirt with a side slit, and a chain belt with
a cross charm. A black choker, layered
silver necklaces, and small hoop
earrings complete the look. Tall black
boots show at the hem. Her expression
is calm and direct. Soft, late-afternoon
light and blurred trees. Palette of violet,
black, and sage green. Nostalgic and
moody, in the style of a boho gothic
editorial.
